topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: The marks on my creation, they did not come from my hand. Yet, they sit there, now a part of it. The lines, they twist and turn, telling a story not my own. I watch them, study how they dance with the shadows I crafted. There is a new weight to the piece, a layer I did not foresee. It is not anger I carry, more a quiet observation. The world interacts with what I make, leaving its own brushstrokes. I let it be. The art is not mine alone, it belongs to the touch of all who feel moved to add their whispers.
